candidates.statement: Inventory's redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s), causing inventory 503s, order ReadTimeouts, and gateway 502s on /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs not collected; timeout cause (saturation vs network) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts propagating to inventory 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway 502 on checkout; topology confirms inventory->redis. Redis-side telemetry is absent, so cause of the timeout is unconfirmed.
missing_evidence: Redis server metrics (latency, connections, saturation) for inventory's redis dependency
Inventory service logs/traces confirming redis timeout as the failing dependency
